description: Data payload shape of '<domain>.apply' commands (envelope.data). apply executes the actions returned by the native engine after plan and user confirmation; a snapshot may be taken before a non-dry-run write.

dry_run.description: true when the run only previewed changes (no snapshot taken, no writes).

steps.description: Per-action execution results, in engine order.

snapshot.description: Pre-write snapshot echo, or null in dry-run mode.

link_count.description: Symlink entries recorded in the manifest.

skipped.description: Steps the pipeline skipped by policy (names only), always present.

step.description: One native action result; failures surface as envelope errors as well.

exit_code.description: Process exit code (124 = timeout, 127 = spawn failure).
